title: Critically-Damped Higher-Order Langevin Dynamics for Generative Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2506.21741v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs) represent an entirely new class of generative AI methods that have yet to be fully explored. They use Langevin dynamics, represented as stochastic differential equations, to describe a process that transforms data into noise, the forward process, and a process that transforms noise into generated data, the reverse process. Many of these methods utilize auxiliary variables that formulate the data as a ``position" variable, and the auxiliary variables are referred to as ``velocity", ``acceleration", etc. In this sense, it is possible to ``critically damp" the dynamics. Critical damping has been successfully introduced in Critically-Damped Langevin Dynamics (CLD) and Critically-Damped Third-Order Langevin Dynamics (TOLD++), but has not yet been applied to dynamics of arbitrary order. translated_title: 面向生成建模的临界阻尼高阶朗之万动力学
translated_abstract: 去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）代表了一类尚未被充分探索的全新生成式人工智能方法。这类方法使用以随机微分方程表示的朗之万动力学来描述两个过程：将数据转化为噪声的前向过程，以及将噪声转化为生成数据的反向过程。许多此类方法利用辅助变量，将数据表述为“位置”变量，而辅助变量则被称为“速度”、“加速度”等。从这个意义上说，可以对动力学进行“临界阻尼”处理。临界阻尼已被成功应用于临界阻尼朗之万动力学（CLD）和临界阻尼三阶朗之万动力学（TOLD++），但尚未被应用于任意阶数的动力学。所提出的方法对近期最先进的高阶朗之万动力学（HOLD）进行了推广。
tldr: 该论文提出将临界阻尼技术从CLD和TOLD++推广到任意阶数的高阶朗之万动力学，从而改进基于扩散模型的生成建模方法。
en_tdlr: This paper generalizes critical damping from CLD and TOLD++ to arbitrary-order higher-order Langevin dynamics, improving diffusion-based generative modeling.
